name: Astral-Ria
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, solar wind erosion patterns. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Around the radiation hotspot, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
